facts.value: Reads Fighter through gobj->user_data and tests input.held_buttons[0] & HSD_PAD_LR. Only a nonzero mask evaluates ftCo_80099F1C. On success it forwards the same object to ftCo_8009A228 and returns true; otherwise it returns false. Entry performs common airborne setup and drift clamping, assigns configured x46C to self_vel.y, changes to ftCo_MS_Pass, updates floor_skip, and writes 0xFE to the vertical-stick tilt timer.
facts.rationale: Correct held_inputs to canonical held_buttons[0] and avoid an unproved negative-velocity assertion.

facts.value: Unconditionally performs ftCommon_8007D5D4, ftCommon_ClampAirDrift, self_vel.y=p_ftCommonData->x46C, Fighter_ChangeMotionState(gobj,msid,mf,anim_start,1,0,NULL), mpUpdateFloorSkip, and x671_timer_lstick_tilt_y=0xFE, in that order. It validates neither eligibility nor destination, flags, frame, or floor index. The floor index copied is the one present after the motion-state call. Velocity sign/finiteness and universal retrigger suppression are not established here. Actual Reflector callers supply aerial continuation states and retained frames.
facts.rationale: Preserve exact execution without converting configuration assumptions into invariants.

facts.value: Without an internal eligibility or grounded-status guard, performs common airborne setup and drift clamping, assigns self_vel.y from x46C, changes to ftCo_MS_Pass with Ft_MF_None and arguments 0,1,0,NULL, updates floor_skip from the then-current floor index, and sets the vertical-stick tilt timer to 0xFE. The timer assignment alone does not prove universal retrigger suppression. The bound Pass animation callback calls ftCo_Fall_Enter when its animation query reports no frames remaining, including that helper's specialized routing.
facts.rationale: Remove unsupported grounded-origin and suppression guarantees while preserving verified state binding.
